reviews.text: Just right!!!. Always had great workouts short and long to fit my daily schedule
Fantastic!. I’ve used quite a few yoga apps over the years and Yoga+ by Mary is the absolute best. It’s as if we are in an in person class. Love it.
Mary is the best. I love this app so much. Mary has super fun energy and her flows and sequences are great. My favorite classes are the hip opener ones ✅
Love love love. I have been using this app for almost two years now! I love it! It help gives me the routine I need and helps me slow down and remember, me! You’ll love it too!
Help! Subscribe button doesn’t work. The app looks wonderful but I can’t start my free trial or subscribe. The subscription buttons seem to be broken, they just spin and never open a new page.
Needs a bug fix. The classes look really cool & are organized nicely - unfortunately every time I try to start a class & confirm my subscription it just loads & loads & loads. Bummer!

Mary is the BEST. I love her. She is so sweet and she make yoga less intimidating. She goes at a great pace and her voice is soothing to listen too as she is instructing you on each pose. I’ve had her app for close to 4 years now and I will never go without it. Love ya Mary 🤘🏼

Amazing!!. I have been using this app on and off for the last two years and I cannot recommend it enough! I love that Mary encourages the participants to honor their body and move at a pace that feels good for them! Mary’s voice is so kind and encouraging! This is a yoga app for anyone!

I love this app!!. I’ve been using this app for like five years now and I love it so much! I was never into yoga but for some reason Mary keeps me invested and I always feel so good after doing one of the videos. They’re explained well and can be as challenging as you want them to be. Recommended to many people and will co to us to do so!

Love the app!. It makes it so easy to take the class I want with the easy and intuitive way to navigate through the different classes.

And it has a class for every mod, every level of difficulty so you are set for any type of yoga your body needs!

Such a great variety!. I’ve been following Mary for a couple of years on IG, and when she launched her app I downloaded it right away. What a great variety Mary has! There’s fast, slow, easy, moderate and more challenging classes with a variety of times, meditation, breath work and merchandise! Best if all, you don’t have to purchase the app and some of her classes are FREE! I’ve learned a lot from her classes, especially about breathing, and about giving yourself grace. Please give the app a try, you will not regret it!

Amazing app for any level!. I love this app and am so grateful for Mary! I appreciate the modifications and options she provides for poses. You can find quick practices all the way to longer flows. There are “challenges” if you don’t know where to start and even some non-yoga workouts! This app really is the total package with the new addition of breathwork too! You won’t regret downloading this app!

Mary is a LIGHT!. I’ve been doing yoga for many years but just joined Mary’s app last year. She is the most genuine, inspiring teacher I’ve ever had. The yoga challenges are my favorite but I can always find something no matter what I feel like doing that day. She really is a bright light and I feel like I’ve made more progress in my journey with her guidance in less than a year than in all my years practicing. Recommend forever!

What can I say about Mary. Her practice came into my life during the pandemic. It gave me hope, peace and made me feel part of a community when I was alone at home. I have continued to follow her 3 years later. She is encouraging and a phenomenal instructor. With her training I now feel knowledgeable and confident attending any yoga class. ❤️ Elle
Wonderful yoga app!. I have been using Mary’s yoga app for 9 months now and highly recommend it! Her instruction is easy to follow and great for all levels.

Love it!. I followed Mary Ochsner on Instagram and discovered her yoga app! I love the way she demonstrates and teaches. She’s the best yoga instructor! I’ve come across a lot of yoga videos/ online instructors & I’m sticking with her yoga app! I love their there’s a variety of options and styles of yoga so that it can fit the individuals’ need for their day. It’s also perfect for people of all levels of yoga. Mary has a sunny uplifting energy that motivates me to get on the mat everyday. Thank you (:

Gracerv7. I always wanted to do Yoga because the poses are beautiful to me and I had heard it can help with imbalances in the body. However, going to studios was too expensive and often times intimidating for me. 

I found this app just before Covid and it was during this time my practice really took off. I love the variety of classes and how you can really grow with the app as your practice improves. 

I also like the gentle reminders that this is for you, everything can be modified, and its ok to have a clumsy day on the mat. Just get back on. 

I’m very grateful to Mary for making this such a beginner friendly to advanced app and I’m loving all the new features she is integrating in. If I kept going to the studios I never would have stuck with it. So Thank You!

Beginner friendly!. I have followed Mary on the gram for a while now & with the new year decided to try her app - it is AMAZING! I feel more powerful and capable with each move! Even if it’s not perfect, Mary stresses that’s ok and offers variations to meet you where you are at. The time flies and I feel rejuvenated after.

Love this app!. I had always wanted to practice yoga but was nervous because I’m not super flexible. A friend recommended this app to me and I really enjoy all of Mary’s classes. Highly recommend this app!

Love Yoga by Mary. The app is really good for beginners as Mary does a good job of explaining poses and tips to help if you’re not as flexible. She’s very encouraging during the classes and has a contagious happiness about her. I especially love the monthly challenges. It’s a good way of getting into the groove of doing yoga everyday because you want to complete the challenge.

My favorite yoga app!. I cannot say enough good things about this app! Mary helps to keep me motivated with challenges and the daily trackers. There is a class for whatever you are in the mood for or even have time for! I’m in my last trimester of pregnancy and have loved the included pregnancy yoga courses! Absolutely worth it and could not live my life without this amazing yoga app!

Happiness Abounds. I love the positive, happy vibes of this program. I am currently completing a 14 day free trial but intend to purchase again. The intermediate/advanced Vinyasa flow practices are amazing. I’ve also done some of the mediation sessions. Love it! ❤️

Helped form a yoga habit!. I have used this app over the past few years on and off, participating in monthly challenges and free classes here and there. I love Mary’s teaching style and personality, and the app is very user friendly. This January I’ve stuck with using the app daily for a monthly challenge. No issues with pairing to my wireless headphones or with any crashes/glitches. Thanks for making yoga at home such a great and relaxing experience!

Amazing app even for bignners!. This is app is wonderful!! It has all the options for you, long and short classes according to your schedule. Mary is so sweet and she breakdown each pose so you can be able to do it. I didn’t do yoga before, and it was easy to follow her instructions to do the pose 💙.

Challenging, but come as you are!. I absolutely love the monthly challenges! They are designed to be challenging so you can improve your practice, but Mary constantly reminds you to have grace and accept yourself just as you are today! Practice not perfection:) I love that the app gives daily reminders to get on your mat, and also provides inspirational/positive quotes every day!

New year, new toe touching ability. I love this app! I had to quit my favorite yoga studio recently to cute back on costs, the membership was $160/month, and I’m happy to have found Yoga+ as my replacement of choice! 

There’s a wide array of choices for a paid membership and even a few classes for an unpaid membership. I really appreciate having top notch classes at my finger tips :’)
Excellent yoga app. It is nice to be able to chose any yoga workout. I can mirror the app to my tv for easy watching. I enjoy the breathework also. I appreciate that I can save my favorites too!

Perfect for all levels!. There’s so much goodness (including Breathwork!) and something for everyone on this app to meet you right where you’re at. Mary is so full of light and guides in such a loving way where there’s no judgement or worry about getting being perfect in the practice. It’s about showing up as you are and for yourself. Just started the January challenge and loving it! Highly recommend this app :)
Easy to follow!. Im not a yogi by any means, but Mary makes it so easy to follow along and not get overwhelmed. Love it!

Mary is the best! ❤️. Mary is the absolute best! Her classes are approachable, I never feel like what she is teaching is out of my reach. I love the fact that I can choose from the monthly challenges, or choose from my favorite classes for what my body needs in a day. 

Mary is kind and encouraging, which makes it easier to open the app and work out. I NEVER pay for apps, but this is SO worth it to me, and so much better than a gym. I also love the encouraging pop up notifications. Thank you Mary for creating this, I love it!

Amazing, supportive teacher!. I’m new to the app, but my first class was exactly what I needed. Mary is so encouraging and wise throughout the practice and I’ve already learned so much! It’s the physical and emotional reset I need everyday.

change your life. I started with Mary per her little instagram clips in the early hours before work as a way to ease tension/pain in my neck and shoulders and as a way to relieve my anxiety from a very stressful job. I went on to get a lifetime membership with her app. Mary made it so easy to start and it changed my life. I've since had wrist surgery due to a work injury that set me back for a very long time. I am now able to start doing my practice again a little at a time. It doesn't matter where you start she makes it comfortable for any level you are at or any age for that matter! I love you Mary!! Thank you!!
Subscription. I wanted a app so I could do yoga and I would not have to pay so I downloaded this app it said it was free and there were a bunch of good reviews and it asks you to pay 15$ a month

The only practical and rational pace you can keep on.. All other yoga classes are too rush to the next pose. This is the only one let me take the time to look at the screen and learn and still have the time to practice! Appreciate the thoughtfulness the instructor brought!

I love Mary and this app!. Thank you Mary for all you do!! 
Fell in love with yoga because of you and I always feel 1000 times better after practicing 💖

This app is amazing!!!. I downloaded the app as soon as it was released and it immediately became the best fitness app I’ve ever tried. Pre-pandemic, I was going to yoga classes 5-6 times a week. Yoga+ has been my entire yoga class practice since then. There are classes for every level of experience and flexibility, classes that fit every mood, and classes that break down individual poses in a way that helps even experienced yogis learn something. Say Goodbye to Stress was just a lifesaver for soothing pandemic burnout. Mary is such a great teacher!! I’m currently in yoga teacher training and can only hope to be half the teacher she is. If you’re going to download just one yoga app, make it Yoga+!

My Absolute favorite Yoga at home❤️ !!!!. I have been following Mary on Instagram since 2011 and always been a yoga fan and have been doing practice on and off since 2011 with back Issues. I have been lagging since 2016 to start Yoga practice but always had a challenge to stick to going to yoga practice everyday. I love this Yoga+ app❤️. I finally decided to download it and start with 2022 New Year Challenge🔥❤️‍🔥. It’s been extremely helpful during the pandemic and gives me flexibility to practice yoga whatever time I’m able to do so and so far has not skip a single day in January 2022. Dealing with Thyroid and PCOS has had its major drawbacks in my life. With gaining weight and hair loss😔. Yoga app has kept me centered and relaxed even when my symptoms have completely obliterated me physically and emotionally. It had made positive influence on me by keeping my head clear and my body to its fullest and brightest level by yoga and positive quotes that you send everyday after class. You will not regret signing up for Mary yoga app. THANK YOU 🙏and will be grateful to you forever🙏🤗😍

Simple navigation, great workouts, calming voice. Love the quality of Mary’s yoga workouts and her calming voice. Tried Kayla Itsines app, but that was too complicated for me, so I’m returning back to Yoga+.
So great!. I love Mary! I’ve been following her on Instagram and got the app for her January challenge. I’m hooked! She’s a great teacher for beginners.

Perfect!. I just completed her 31 day challenge and it was absolutely perfect. The app was so easy to navigate, high quality videos, great sound. Mary’s knowledge and encouragement is beautiful. Just an overall great experience and app!

Simply everything about this app!. My sweet friend introduced me to Mary & the Yoga+ app and it’s been love ever since!🙏

We love doing the monthly yoga challenges 
together! This app truly brought me back to a consistent yoga routine and I’m so grateful!

Mary is an excellent yoga instructor who takes the time to guide you through each movement, and offering cues and modifications along the way. Her energy is the right blend of calm & bright!🙏 Try out a class or 20, you won’t regret it!!!
My favorite!. Love Mary, love this app! She makes my practice so easy and enjoyable.
Love it. I really enjoy the range of classes she has. When I have zero motivation, I remember I can do 5min yoga stretches in bed. She has free classes on this app too.
Speechless. I only did 2 free courses and this deserves a rating because wow. So relaxing for the mind, body and soul. I cannot wait to explore with her.

Life changing. I am forever grateful for finding Mary on Instagram because it changed my life forever. Thanks to Mary, I’ve been doing yoga everyday for over a year now and I will continue to in the future. This is perfect for beginners. She’s an amazing teacher.
The only program for me. I’ve tried all of the trendy type apps, hoping they would be what I’m looking for, but Mary is the only instructor for me

Balance. This app has an incredible array of options from beginner to advanced. Mary shares her incredible energy in a very mindful way. She has an amazing way of transitioning yoga into a lifestyle. There are many options if you’re new to yoga and Mary is great at explaining the positions. 
Personally, I do the morning routines and currently started the 30 day morning challenge. It’s great, quick, and fun way to start my mornings.
Beautiful soul. I’m truly grateful for you as in instructor for my yoga practice. It’s been a rough few months and I’m so glad I found your app! Thank you

Great start!. I’ve been thinking of this app for months though I stayed with my other subscription. Today is the day I decided to switch to this app and I am very excited! It feels so real so connected to life.

Sending Love for Saudi Arabia. I loved Mary from her Instagram account and I had a nice time doing yoga 🧘‍♀️ with her videos this app is a perfect way for working on your body and your soul too , I definitely recommend this app for all 
Great job 👏🏻 mary 
Love you 😘

Five star recipe for the perfect yoga instructor. I’ve been digging into this App for many months now. Mary serves up yoga technique and cues that are intuitive and clear so the poses make sense. She blends in some hard work and teaches you to “find your edge.” Sprinkle that with Mary’s Midwestern sweetness and garnish it with breath-work and self-kindness amd mindfulness and you have a recipe for personal growth through the art of Yoga. I’ve shared this app with many friends and they all come back for more. Bon app!

Motivating yoga app. In the midst of the COVID pandemic, this app is just what I needed! I have followed Mary on Instagram for a long time and have done many of her stretches, and, now, finally started using the app with the New Year’s Challenge! I wish I had not waited so long to try it out because it has been life changing! I am more relaxed and sleep better after doing each practice. Her classes are calm and motivating and she inspires me to do more than I thought my body was capable of doing! If you have any inclination to practice yoga, this app is a great way to do it!

Best Yoga App & Instructor Ever. This app exceeded my expectations and my expectations were high. There’s a boatload of content, from challenging flows to quick stretches. Mary is a fantastic instructor. Her directions are easy to follow and she’s very reassuring. I wasn’t doing yoga before this but I’ve been consistent since getting the app. I now have a practice I can call my own. Highly recommended.

Favorite Yoga App!. I have never felt so in tune with my mind and body thanks to Mary’s practices! The January 2021 challenge has been perfect for this newbie. So happy with my choice to start practicing, and Mary is a wonderful teacher! 🙏🏻💖

I started 2020 with shoulder pain.... 2020 did not start to great for me. I had severe shoulder pain, and woke up in the middle of the night with what felt like a frozen shoulder. I couldn’t move anymore and had trouble breathing.

Thankfully nothing severe was wrong! Turned out that I did not stretch enough while I was sitting at the desk, and my posture was not helping things either … so I started doing stretches and yoga. 

I discovered Mary Ochsner on IG! Now I am addicted, and if I do not stretch every day my back is definitely reminding me! 😊

I guess once you injured yourself you are extra careful, however I love how much more flexible I have become and the stretches are amazing to increase your flexibility and mindfulness. Thanks Mary💕

Such a Supportive Yogi!!. Mary is amazing and so encouraging in her practice. She walks and talks you through the flows and positions. I was new to the practice and I’m blown away by my increased flexibility and improved breathing techniques in just three weeks!
Thank you. Great app. Has helped me reconnect with my yoga practice!!

10/10. Yoga for all experience levels!! Mary used to teach at the yoga studio I attend and I was always SO EXCITED to see her on the schedule. Her classes have the right element of difficulty but she makes it feel so easy. I love that this app offers monthly challenges too to keep me motivated for daily practice!! Keep it up, Mary, we love you!!

Mary’s got your back!. I absolutely adore Mary’s app. I used to practice irregularly, but started up again just in time for this app to save me from going bananas. I work from home part-time, but December had me working full-time hours with 2 small kiddos at home. I was literally working 6a-6p so this app was my ONE chance to have me-time daily. I’m currently on a 49 day streak (which the app tracks for you and is AMAZING for accountability). Now my 5yo son, 2yo daughter, and 8yo kitty all love practicing with me. Also, her reminder to smile during practice is so positive and endearing. Her positivity is unparalleled. One of my 2021 goals is to practice and use this app everyday!
LOVE IT. This app is perfect for a beginner. She helped me become more comfortable in each pose and the daily encouragement is a huge plus! I’ve recommended this app to alllll my friends!!

Perfect Yoga App. Mary is the perfect teacher for the kind of yoga I love. It’s great for beginners, but also challenging for anyone. She mixes it up and I love her monthly challenge! Her practices are the perfect length for my day! Cannot recommend more!

Such an amazing journey!. I’ve tried yoga many times over the years and never felt the desire to stick with it. I’ve tried in-person classes, but felt sooo behind. I’ve tried YouTube and DVDs, and felt more frustrated than anything. Mary has a wonderful way of teaching, especially to a beginner like me! I always look forward to the next day/class and what it will bring and always come out feeling refreshed and joyful.

No more back pain!. After having two kids, my core was shot and I was starting to experience a lot of low back pain. After doing the daily challenges on this app for the past few weeks, I can tell I’m getting stronger and more flexible, and - best of all - my back pain is starting to subside. This is doing more than MONTHS of physical therapy was doing for me! Plus, at around 30 minutes a day, it’s totally doable for my schedule with little ones running around. Great app, highly recommend!!

I USE THIS APP EVERY DAY. I love doing yoga with Mary! She is an awesome yoga instructor. The monthly challenges are my favorite. I can show up without having to spend any energy on a decision of which video to choose. This app is so easy to navigate.

LOVE!!. This App has helped me FINALLY get a consistent yoga practice going! I started with the New year yoga challenge and will now be a lifetime member. I can practice anywhere, anytime and it has been a saving grace during the pandemic. Mary’s so calming to listen to and she leads you through different variations so as a beginner I don’t feel overwhelmed by poses. It’s such a breath of fresh air to have a professional talk about things she still struggles with in her practice and putting so much emphasis on listening to your body and going at a pace that works best for you. I struggle with chronic pain and I’ve never felt so strong in body and mind as I do with her classes. I love keeping track of my days completed and look forward to the inspirational quotes after each class. I also follow Mary on Instagram as well and love her quick tips and poses for every issue you can think of and when he cat gets in on the action even better:)

This app is LIFE. I love this app so much, it’s gotten me back into the habit of my practice. Mary is such a great instructor, so easy to flow along with. The streak feature is also so amazing as it helps keep me accountable for my progress! Thanks Mary!

Best yoga app around!. I love this app, easy to use and Mary is always coming out with new & fun videos. Meant for all yoga levels. I love that I can take it with my wherever I go. I really enjoy the large amount of choices and lengths of videos Mary is even kinder in person than she is on the videos 😍

Best Online Yoga!. I’ve tried several online yoga apps and this is by far my favorite! Mary is so good at explaining the poses for beginners like me, which is even more important when you’re practicing at home. The variety of classes is also amazing. Her new year challenge has helped me get back into yoga and I’m feeling so good about myself and my journey! Thank you, Mary!

Uplifting and genuine. Mary is a great teacher for all levels of yogis. Her app is easy to navigate and very encouraging. Her practice allows students to engage at their own pace and she does a great job keeping it simple and most importantly genuine!
Daily Practice. This app has been helpful for me to keep up my daily yoga practice. Love the reminders and the Positive Vibes!

Great way to work out at home!. I’ve loved using this app the past year to work out at home. The sessions are good for beginners and those who are more advanced. Good for muscle strengthening and stretching.

Just what I needed!. I have followed Mary on instagram for a while now and I downloaded the app when I heard about the free new year yoga challenge. I love doing yoga but I normally get bored with workout programs that repeat the same things over and over. This app and the yoga challenge in particular have been amazing because there is so much variety and you can pretty much do something different every day even in the free version! I am loving this app so far and plan to keep using it for a long time!

High quality yoga app. I highly recommend this wonderful user-friendly yoga app! Mary Ochsner gives you a wide variaty of classes at different levels and indifferent durations. The app includes monthly challenges that keeps you motivated to show up and practice consistently. A great tool if you want to increase your flexibility and strength!

Love the variety. Downloading the app is definitely worth it, Mary provides free classes to try out which is amazing! I love that there is a variety of types of classes available and they also all vary in lengths which is nice when I have to squeeze in a quick workout or prefer to do a deeper more intensive session. Definitely want to check out buying a membership and I am pregnant now and could use a little more 1:1 training!

Best Yoga App for all levels!!!. This is one of the best apps for all levels. The price is perfect with different options. The options are endless, from the monthly challenges to repeating your favorite flows. Plus Mary is adorable!

Love this app!. I’ve used this app for about three years now and I followed Mary on Instagram for about a year or two before that and let me tell you this has not disappointed!!! It is a great way to develop a routine and keep yourself motivated. Her whole vibe is so calming and peaceful. This is hands down worth the download! She even has free courses available!!

My favorite yoga app!. I’ve been using this app for around 2 years now and I absolutely love it! Mary is a wonderful teacher and I really like her style, which is the most important part of any yoga class in my opinion. I also love the wide variety of class options on the app. No matter what kind of a mood I’m in, if I need a full body workout or a gentle stretch, Mary has a class for me! The monthly challenges are also a great way to stay motivated and try things I otherwise wouldn’t. Definitely recommend!

Best Virtual Yoga!. I have loved using Mary’s app for yoga! She is great about reminding you of your posture and pushing you to challenge yourself while also making sure we are smiling and honoring our bodies. I’ve become stronger and more confident because of these classes, and I’m so grateful!

Love this app. This app is so helpful, easy to navigate, and significantly helped my home yoga practice! Mary is an excellent teacher and the app provides a variety of flows and helps keep track of my practice! Love it!

Best Yoga App. I’ve done yoga here or there but never consistently. I saw Mary through Instagram and when there was a challenge for the beginning of the year I dove in. Mary is able to talk you through poses and alternatives with ease. If somethings to intense, she makes sure you know you don’t have to do it. It’s also a very calming part of my day. I’ve never been more motivated to keep yoga going from day to day.

Constant Refreshing my Body ❤️. I am a full beginner on the practice and I don’t know anything about yoga, and this year my main goal is to better my body and mind and with thousands of app out there Mary’s app is the one I genuinely appreciate of learning. I have long ways to go but her app encouraged me to be on every day and complete the day with having a clear mind and completely aware of every parts of my body.

Begin Yoga Here. After a literal years of thinking about starting yoga, this is the app that got me to do it. Mary gives clear instruction that makes you feel like part of a community and she always gives tips for how to adapt movements for people who are beginning or less flexible. This makes her lessons particularly enjoyable to follow. She encourages you the whole way, has an encyclopedic library of yoga flows with varying amounts of difficulty, and gives clear instructions to improve your form. Whatever you were looking for, you will find it here.

Very helpful. I recently started using this app after seeing Mary’s new year challenge classes on Instagram. I never thought it would be so helpful. Mary’s yoga classes are small and so detailed. It helps to attain and show up to yoga mat every single day. All the classes are different so that each day your body gets to experience new moves. I enjoy these classes and never get bored. The classes are designed for every level along with modifications. The app is very organized and easy to use. You can learn in your own pace using this app. Monthly challenges are amazing. Moreover Mary is always smiling and reaffirms you it’s ok to be where you are.
Thankful. I’m so thankful for your free sessions to get me back into yoga and staying healthy!

Mary is the energy I need. Mary has such a pure energy. Rather than hit the snooze button in the morning, I open up the app for the extra motivation to get up and yoga on. Her monthly challenges help me to set attainable goals especially while doing yoga at home. I highly recommend starting your day doing yoga with Mary because her energy grounds you.

BEST YOGA APP. Yes, I am screaming.....honestly the best yoga app ever! Mary is so encouraging throughout each session, offering variations for the novice and less flexible. So far, I have only participated in the monthly challenge and used the position guide to improve some moves, but I have been thrilled with the app. Mary is energetic and positive without being “ syrupy.” Check Mary out on Instagram, that is where I started and got hooked. Why not download this app? What do you have to lose? Do yoga daily!

Excellent Yoga App. I am really enjoying this app. The videos are very well done and Mary is very patient and encouraging. Since I am just beginning my yoga journey this has been an excellent place to start. I am looking forward to challenging myself and exploring yoga through this app. Definitely recommend this app.

The Best Yoga App +More. First, Mary is amazing. She gives a very genuine and sincere energy. The app has so many options for beginners and flows for every level of yoga. She has added so much to the app (breathwork, meditation, quotes) to truly grow in more than just yoga but mentally. This app is one of my resources I use to keep up with self care and I love it!

great yoga app to start the year!. I started this app with the new year daily challenge a couple of weeks ago. We found out we were pregnant with #2 in early November and then found out a few days after Christmas that I was miscarrying. What a way to start the year :(
A friend of mine suggested this app to me, as I felt I needed to slowly move my body, take time to love myself, rejuvenate and breath. This app has easy daily practice with lots of variations for different levels. It has helped me so much in the new year and finding some balance, love, and stretch back into my life. The classes are 20-30 min, easy to follow, and easy to find time to do with a one year old! I have done yoga on and off for many years- but I feel confident I will stick with Mary’s programs for a long time!

✨amazing ✨. I really love doing yoga with this app. Mary’s voice is really nice to listen to, especially if i’ve just woken up for morning yoga. Her videos are super easy to follow, unlike experiences with other yoga apps i’ve had. Overall very good!

Yay yoga!. I love Mary’s simple and safe approach to practicing yoga. The perfect balance of instructional and flow. Not once did I feel overwhelmed with poses or jargon, but always found space to keep it simple or move forward with a challenge. The videos are clean, free of distractions and are well done. This app is my go-to when I don’t want to lead myself and just want to follow and be led. Thanks, Mary!

Great for all levels of yogis!. I have been doing yoga for years and have switched from teacher to teacher but Mary is so wonderful! She explains things for everyone to understand no matter how long you’ve been doing yoga for! I recommend her to anyone that wants to try yoga for the first time! She has changed the game of yoga by having this app with flows that range from 5 minutes to 20 minutes which is great for someone who just wants to incorporate yoga in a small part of their day!

You can’t go wrong with this app!. I have tried many beginner yoga apps or online classes and this is the first one that I’ve actually stuck with! Mary explains everything so well and doesn’t move through poses too quickly so I’m able to follow along as a newbie. Her voice and demeanor is calming and makes you feel at peace. You can tell she truly loves yoga and teaching others and even when your holding a pose for what seems like eternity she talks you through it and makes you believe in yourself. Like I said you can’t go wrong with this app!

Brings Beginners Along for the Ride. I was told about Mary’s app by a friend who had started a New Years challenge on it. Never have I been able to stay consistent in my yoga practice until now. Her classes really take me along as a beginner. They meet me where I’m at but also challenge me to keep growing. Highly recommend this app to anybody who feels intimidated to start yoga, Mary brings you along the journey in a welcoming and wonderful way!

Great app!. This app is amazing! Mary is a great teacher and I love following her on Instagram. I was thrilled when she came out with this app. She’s always adding new videos and there are TONS of options for practices! I love how the classes are divided by type, and then you can see the video length before you begin the practice. I can always find a class to fit into my time frame!

My new fav way to practice yoga. Discovered the app few weeks back and could not wait to try it . I am loving it so far .The app provides variety of classes - breath work, balance , strength just to name a few . All the classes provide great explanation and options for modification depending on where you are at in your yoga journey .
